requirement: A and D execute under one frozen Codex isolation profile.
mechanism: Both routes import W01/profile_argv.py and call isolation_argv(load_profile()). Neither route may construct, extend, reorder or override the isolation argv segment locally.

assertions.A_D_CONFIG_BYTES_IDENTICAL: isolation_argv() output of A and D compared element-wise and as a NUL-joined sha256
assertions.A_D_MODEL_EFFORT_PARITY: model=gpt-6-astra and model_reasoning_effort=high live INSIDE the shared profile, so neither route can diverge
assertions.KNOWN_TOOL_SURFACES_DISABLED: every packet key present in config_overrides with the observed supported form
assertions.PROJECT_CONTEXT_DISABLED: project_doc_max_bytes == 0 and skills.include_instructions == false and include_apps_instructions == false
assertions.REPOSITORY_CWD_FORBIDDEN: assert_repository_cwd_forbidden() raises before dispatch if cwd is the repo or beneath it

route_specific_allowed_outside_isolation.rule: These are per-route I/O bindings, not isolation settings. They must never carry a -c override or a sandbox/feature flag.
